playground.demos.storeBoundary.descripti.message: Verifies that field values are managed by Ant Design Form, while effects only update field values or DynamicForm meta.

playground.demos.customHandlers.descript.message: Shows how custom EffectResultHandler implementations update values, field meta, and dynamic styles.

playground.demos.customComponents.descri.message: Shows how to register custom components and display the form in detail-view mode.

playground.demos.formValidation.descript.message: Shows how standard fields and complex Form.List components share Ant Design Form validation.

playground.demos.uiConfig.description.message: Shows how static uiConfig merges with dynamic UI config returned by effects.

playground.demos.renderExtension.descrip.message: Shows render extension parameters and custom component registration extension points.

playground.demos.compilerFoundation.desc.message: Shows how field modules compile into standard FormConfig before rendering with DynamicForm.

playground.client.description.message: Select a demo to inspect the interactive behavior.

api.groups.components.description.message: Primary React entry points for rendering standard config or compiler/adapter output.

api.groups.hooks.description.message: Initialize effect handlers, access context, and reuse store initialization logic.

api.groups.configTypes.description.message: Describe form config, field config, UI config, render hook parameters, and core value types.

api.groups.componentRegistry.description.message: Register or extend field components and access the default Ant Design component set.

api.groups.compilerModules.description.message: Compile domain field modules into standard FormConfig while preserving the runtime rendering pipeline.

api.groups.adapters.description.message: Normalize ModuleConfig, JsonSchema, OpenAPI, or metadata inputs into module configs.

api.groups.rules.description.message: Declarative synchronous rule layer that compiles to standard effects and reuses the existing handler pipeline.

api.groups.fieldAddress.description.message: Separates stable field ids from Ant Design NamePath and supports nested value paths.

api.groups.utilities.description.message: Default config and config processing entry points for advanced integrations and tests.

api.page.description.message: This page groups public exports from packages/dynamic-form/src/exports.ts by purpose as a quick lookup entry. The topic docs remain the source of detailed behavior.

examples.minimal.description.message: Render basic fields from a flat FormConfig and delegate submit handling to Ant Design Form.

examples.grouped.description.message: Organize fields in groups, using the default Card layout or replacing the shell with render hooks.

examples.effects.description.message: Use dependents and effect to return visible, disabled, value, or render meta updates.

examples.customComponents.description.message: Register business field components with componentRegistry while DynamicForm still manages runtime props.

examples.customHandlers.description.message: Map effect return values to business semantics while keeping components focused on rendering.

examples.compilerAdapter.description.message: Adapt JsonSchema, OpenAPI, or metadata into module config, then compile it into standard FormConfig.

examples.layout.description.message: Scenario-based DynamicForm examples with docs and playground links.

examples.page.description.message: Find configuration entry points by scenario, with concise snippets, full documentation links, and interactive playground links.

homepage.features.configDriven.descripti.message: Describe fields, groups, validation, and UI config with FormConfig, keeping Ant Design Form usage behind a stable configuration layer.

homepage.features.effectsRuntime.descrip.message: Execute dependency chains through form-chain-effect-engine and resolve rendering, submit, disabled, readonly, and validation capabilities through the Runtime Layer.

homepage.features.extensionPoints.descri.message: Supports custom components, effect result handlers, render hooks, compiler, adapters, and a declarative rule layer.

homepage.flow.adapterCompiler.descriptio.message: Normalize external schemas, metadata, or field modules into standard FormConfig.

homepage.flow.stateRuntime.description.message: Store structure and meta, then resolve rendered, editable, validatable, and related capabilities in one place.

homepage.flow.consumerEffects.descriptio.message: Render Ant Design Form and route field effect results through semantic handlers.

homepage.paths.start.description.message: Start from installation, minimal config, and field config to run your first DynamicForm.

homepage.paths.examples.description.message: Find examples for minimal forms, groups, effects, custom components, and the compiler pipeline.

homepage.paths.playground.description.message: Run existing demos directly to inspect form effects, validation, render hooks, and extension behavior.

homepage.paths.api.description.message: Review public exports grouped by components, hooks, compiler, adapters, rules, and types.

homepage.layout.description.message: DynamicForm is a dynamic form library built with React, TypeScript, and Ant Design.

homepage.hero.subtitle.message: A dynamic form library built with React, TypeScript, and Ant Design. Describe form structure with config, handle field dependencies with effect chains, and centralize runtime participation policy in the Runtime Layer.

homepage.workflow.description.message: DynamicForm separates input normalization, runtime capabilities, and UI rendering into clear layers for reuse, extension, and verification.

homepage.paths.description.message: The site is organized for learning, lookup, verification, and API reference.

playground.layout.description.message: Interactive DynamicForm demos powered by the shared demo registry.
